description_en: Queries the list of interactive messaging applications by calling ListLiveMessageApps
description_zh: 调用ListLiveMessageApps查询互动消息应用列表
name: ListLiveMessageApps

parameters.help_en:
The sort type by creation time. Valid values:
1: ascending order.
2: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，按创建时间先后进行排序。取值：
1：顺序
2：逆序
parameters.name: sort_type

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the query page. If this parameter is left empty or set to -1, the first page is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页的起始位置，若为空或者-1则默认为首页
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.help_en: The data center. The value must be the same as the data center specified in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html. Valid values: cn-shanghai (China (Shanghai)) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore)
parameters.help_zh: 数据中心，需要与https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848162.html中的数据中心一致，当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）
parameters.name: data_center

AppList.description_en: The list of interactive messaging applications

AppId.description_en: The ID of the interactive messaging application
AppId.description_zh: 所查询的互动消息应用ID

AppKey.description_en: The AppKey of the interactive messaging application. This value is required for authentication of related operations on this application
AppKey.description_zh: 互动消息应用的AppKey，在该互动消息应用ID的相关操作鉴权时需要该信息

AppSign.description_en: The signature of the interactive messaging application. This value is required by the interactive messaging SDK
AppSign.description_zh: 互动消息应用签名，互动消息服务SDK需要该信息

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time, represented as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒

Disable.description_en: Indicates whether the interactive messaging application is disabled
Disable.description_zh: 该互动消息应用是否被禁用

ModifyTime.description_en: The modification time, represented as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
ModifyTime.description_zh: 修改时间，用UNIX时间戳表示，单位：秒

MsgLifeCycle.description_en:
The storage duration tier for group messages within the application. Valid values:

0: Default value. Messages are stored for 30 days.
1: Messages are stored for 90 days.
2: Messages are stored for 180 days
MsgLifeCycle.description_zh:
App内群组消息的存储时效档位，取值：

0：默认值，存储30天。
1：存储90天。
2：存储180天

HasMore.description_en: Indicates whether there is a next page

NextPageToken.description_en: The starting position of the next page. This parameter is returned only when HasMore is set to true
NextPageToken.description_zh: 下一页的起始位置，Hasmore为true时返回
